items.description: Transparent civic intelligence separating identity, primary evidence, preference signaling, and future SmartDAO governance.
items.entry_copy: Public informational Vote pages exist. The candidate and funding application remains an unfinished internal PoC. Enter uses the existing Member Portal.
items.name: Vote/Ballots
items.outcome: Voters inspect primary candidate funding and factual-claim evidence before choosing how to signal mandates.
items.pain: Opaque PAC money and unverified campaign rhetoric collapse evidence, persuasion, and identity together.
items.solution: Incubating PoC: funding/oversight maps + planned claim-verification rubric; Proto adds auditable preference signals.
items.tagline: Follow the money. Know your candidates.
items.title: Vote/Ballots

items.description: Agentic market research and structured signal evaluation discipline built on FoundUps compute.
items.entry_copy: Incubating Phase 0: simulation and dry-run only. No launched trading app, live trades or capital execution is claimed.
items.name: Trade
items.outcome: Independent participants convert verifiable agent compute into disciplined, transparent market intelligence.
items.pain: Retail participants face institutional information asymmetry and unverified hype signals.
items.solution: Incubating spec & module scaffold: risk-bounded research agents and backtested signal evaluation.
items.title: Trade

items.description: Quake-style gamified stream moderation turning live-chat spam defense into community XP.
items.entry_copy: MAGADOOM remains in shell discovery mode while its public-facing test expectations are brought back into line.
items.name: MAGADOOM
items.outcome: Live-stream communities turn toxic chat moderation into fast, transparent, collaborative play.
items.pain: Volunteer stream moderators burn out fighting coordinated spam and harassment invisibly.
items.solution: Incubating engine: YouTube Live moderation events mapped to Quake-style XP and leaderboards.
items.title: MAGADOOM

items.description: Linked 15-second educational story, music, and caption episodes paired with EDUIT play-based learning.

items.outcome: Educators and parents turn a teaching prompt into coherent 15-second musical story episodes with synced captions.
items.pain: Short-form kids media optimizes for noisy watch-time loops rather than verified learning progression.
items.solution: Incubating PoC: local episode/caption renderer + story continuity contract linked to EDUIT games.
items.title: Kids Episodes
